intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (4) Côte de Nuillé-sur-Vicoin (155 km)

story: A duo-attack by Team TotalEnergies-teammates Burgaudeau and Vercher in the second half of the stage never posed any threat to the sprinters. Without teammates in the final kilometer, Milan powered to his first Tour de France stage win ahead of Van Aert.
